items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: there was another Pima Indian in the Tuscon High School Orchestra, and a very distant relative. The name is Walker.

ctx.x: You went to Tucson High School there, and how was it as far as your playing music? You started playing the trombone at that time?

Yes. I tell ya how I got to the trombone. I, I went to the band master in Tucson High School, and they were all filled up, every instrument, and I couldn't, I couldn't join the concert band. So they said, "However, we have an opening for a trombonist if you play trombone, we have a opening for a -- in the orchestra." So I said, I said, "Well, I know, I know how to play trombone ,but I got a good back-ground. I don't think it'll take long for me to play trombone." And incidentally, there was another Pima Indian in…

What kinds of music -- you were able to a, get into the concert band that they had, or was it a marching band that they had? What kinds of musical aggregations a, did they have that you performed in actually, once you started getting the trombone down?
